lines.text_source: Welcome to my forge. I'm Destras, the blacksm...
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Bem-vindo à minha forja. Sou Destras, o ferreiro...

lines.text_source: Hey, wait a second! What's that face for?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Ei, espera aí! Por que essa cara?
lines.risk_notes: Tone shift from formal to confrontational; verify if Destras maintains stotic delivery or shows irritation

lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Não era o que você esperava?

lines.text_source: You better not make me mad. I could mould you into a horse trough with this forge, you know!
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Mais vale você não me irritar. Eu consigo moldá-lo num cocho de cavalo com essa forja, sabe?
lines.risk_notes: Threat of violence; metaphor (mould into horse trough) must preserve menace and craft-mastery tone without sounding comedic. Back-translation required to verify menace > humor.

lines.text_source: Alright... Maybe I'm imagining things, but be careful. I've got my eye on you.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Certo... Talvez eu esteja imaginando, mas cuidado. Estou de olho em você.
lines.risk_notes: Shift to vigilance; 'imagining things' suggests paranoia or past trauma; maintain stoic delivery

lines.text_source: My work is my passion, I can't refuse any assignment. Tell me, scrawny, what do you need?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Meu trabalho é minha paixão, não recuso tarefa. Fale, esqueleto, o que você precisa?
lines.risk_notes: Insult 'scrawny' is casual/contemptuous; verify Destras character doesn't soften here. Passion for work contradicts stoic archetype — check lore consistency.
